id: title:dmarchuk:show a per run overview for batch workflows

review.posthog_relevance: Adds batch-specific parameters and comparison views to workflow and batch job UI, including previous run labels, period selection, and run-specific metrics URLs.
review.reason: This chunk is a cohesive group of frontend changes. It adds batch-specific parameters and comparison views to workflow and batch job UI, including previous run labels, period selection, and run-specific metrics URLs. No tier assignment is performed; only observations are returned.
review.uncertainty: This chunk does not include the backend implementation, tests, or release notes. It cannot establish whether the batch workflow and batch-specific UI are production-ready, whether the batch API and warehouse ingestion are compatible, or whether the batch-specific routing and URL parameters are wired end-to-end.

observations.behavior: Adds a new optional prop previousLabel to WorkflowMetricCard, and conditionally suppresses the change pill when a previous label is supplied.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows WorkflowMetricCard to display a human-readable previous run label instead of a bare change pill, supporting batch workflow comparison views.

observations.behavior: Renders a new div showing the previous run label and value, and the change, when previousLabel and previousPeriodTimeSeries are supplied.
observations.posthog_connection: Adds the visual comparison row for batch workflows, displaying the previous run's value alongside the current run and the change.

observations.behavior: Adds requestedAction prop to BatchJobMetrics, and uses it to pass an instanceId to the metrics query, while removing the workflow-dependent action lookup.
observations.code_quote: instanceId: knownActions.some((action) => action.id === requestedAction) ? requestedAction : undefined,
observations.posthog_connection: Allows BatchJobMetrics to receive an action ID from the URL and pass it to the metrics query, supporting batch-specific action selection without relying on workflow-dependent action lookup.

observations.limitations: This chunk is a single, cohesive change group. No unrelated PRs are present. No tier assignment is performed; only observations are returned.

observations.behavior: Adds appSourceId and period parameters to WorkflowMessageLeaderboard, passing appSourceId to metricsStepUrl.
observations.posthog_connection: Connects the leaderboard's metrics URL to the workflow's app source, potentially changing the metrics context. No tier assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds HogFlowBatchJob and period parameters to WorkflowOverview, including run and previousRun props, and updates the metrics query parameters.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the workflow overview to use run-specific parameters rather than a fixed date range, potentially changing the metrics context. No tier assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds appSourceId and period parameters to workflowMetricsSummaryLogic and workflowOverviewLogic, and updates the comparison failure handling.
observations.posthog_connection: Connects the workflow metrics and overview to the app source, potentially changing the metrics context. No tier assigned.

observations.behavior: Adds a period parameter to the displayed tooltip text, changing it from a static string to a dynamic one including the selected period.
observations.posthog_connection: Allows the workflow step reach chart to distinguish between different period selections, potentially supporting batch run or multi-period comparisons.

observations.behavior: Adds a runId parameter to the metrics step URL, passing the current run's ID to the URL builder.
observations.posthog_connection: Supports navigation to a specific run's metrics, distinguishing batch runs from regular workflow runs.

observations.behavior: Adds a previousRunLogicKey prop to WorkflowOverviewLogicProps, allowing the workflow overview to reference a batch run's previous run for comparison.
observations.posthog_connection: Supports batch run comparison by passing the previous run's logic key, enabling batch-specific metrics and comparisons.
